site_audit.platform: Hand-built static HTML (own style.css, Inter from Google Fonts, images/logo.png). No CMS, no page builder, no plugin stack. Three Pexels stock videos are hot-linked as the hero slider background.
site_audit.html_errors: 1 error, 0 warnings, 0 info on the homepage - a single stray <script> start tag after </body> at source line 138. This is the only one of the five whose markup is close to clean, and the trade-off is that almost nothing else is present either: no canonical, no Open Graph, no Twitter card, no JSON-LD, no sitemap reference and only one tracking tag in the whole document.

issues: Your Google Ads conversion event can never record a conversion. The head still carries the template's placeholder label - gtag('event', 'conversion', {'send_to': 'AW-18243186763/WHATSAPP_LABEL'}) with the comment 'Replace with your WhatsApp conversion label' - so every WhatsApp click you pay for is sent to a label that does not exist in your Google Ads account.

Your hero slider is three Pexels stock videos hot-linked straight from pexels.com/download/video/7040278/, /19202862/ and /18680290/. The first thing a prospect sees on a page you pay to send them to is somebody else's stock footage.
The page has no Open Graph tags, no Twitter card, no canonical, no JSON-LD and no sitemap reference, so every link shared anywhere renders as a bare URL with no image and no description.
Your <title> is 108 characters and your three hero slides each carry their own <h1>, so the page competes with itself for three different queries at once.
Your contact page is a single enquiry.html with no phone validation, no email field confirmation and no thank-you state read in this pass.

promise_gap: Google Ads Transparency: 2 live ads under advertiser AR08105928276372881409, verified as LANKA V K PHANI VISWANATH - one of them a YouTube video creative.

The video ad buys attention and the page it lands on opens with three Pexels stock videos, not the advertiser's own installations. The strongest asset - a YouTube creative the company paid to produce - is immediately undercut by the stock footage above it.
The head installs the Google Ads tag AW-18243186763 and defines a WhatsApp conversion event against it.

The event still sends to 'AW-18243186763/WHATSAPP_LABEL' with the template's own comment 'Replace with your WhatsApp conversion label' above it. Google Ads will never record a conversion from this page, so the advertiser is paying for clicks with no measurement of what they produce.
The site presents solar, wind and hydro as three equal service lines, each with its own hero slide, its own <h1> and its own CTA.

The solar line is a genuine rooftop and ground-mount EPC - rooftop solar, ground-mount systems, net metering, battery storage and AMC for residential and commercial plants, with feasibility studies, site surveys and net-metering approvals handled. The wind and hydro lines are described only as equipment trading. The page asks the same attention for all three, and the company describes itself as 'a new bee in this energy sector'.
The page carries a floating WhatsApp button pre-filled with 'Hi Surya Renewable Energies, I need quote for solar power'.

That is the only working conversion path on the site, and because the Google Ads conversion label is a placeholder, the one action the page is built to produce is the one action Google Ads cannot count.
